title: AE Structural Tokens v1
description: Substrate-invariant structural description of a light-field stream — the AI-native output format that both AE Eyes pipelines compile to (Path 1 = codec translator, Path 2 = retinal transform). Every field is a deterministic extraction; no neural inference is required to produce this record. The AI consumes structural tokens directly instead of learning perception from pixels. See AE_STRUCTURAL_TOKENS_v1.md for the design doctrine and the two-path synthesis.

id.description: Deterministic id of this structural record (sha256 of source + extraction params, hex, 16+ chars).

provenance.description: Which path produced these tokens and from what.

path.description: codec = compressed-domain translator; retinal = differential-field transform.

source_id.description: Optional: origin identifier (file path sha, sensor id, session id).

translator_version.description: Version of the deterministic translator/transform used. Non-neural.

extracted_at_ms.description: Unix ms when extracted. Deterministic under a fixed seed if the pipeline is run in seeded mode.

photometric.description: Substrate metadata the AI can reason about or ignore. Kept separate so structural fields carry scene, not display.

gamma.description: Encoded gamma exponent. 1.0 = linear, ~2.2 = sRGB display.

resolution.description: [width, height] in pixels of the source frame(s).

temporal.description: Timeline metadata for the token stream.

frame_count.description: Number of source frames processed. 1 for a still image.

sample_rate_hz.description: Effective temporal sample rate of the token stream (may be higher than source fps for retinal transforms fed by high-rate sensors).

entities.description: Persistent, identity-preserved objects across time. Path 1 aggregates codec motion-compensated block groups whose motion is coherent. Path 2 aggregates spatiotemporal regions whose gradient + motion signatures track together.

id.description: Stable within this record. Not globally unique — cross-record identity is a separate concern.

region.description: Bounding box in pixel coordinates: [x, y, w, h]. Present on still-image entities and any sequence entity that has a persistent spatial support.

motion_field.description: Sparse motion samples: {ts_ms, vx, vy, confidence, region: [x,y,w,h]}. vx/vy in normalized frame units per second.

texture_codes.description: Indices into the record-level texture vocabulary. Structural texture identity, not pixel values.

prediction_residual_norm.description: Mean magnitude of the codec/transform's residual for this entity across its lifespan. High = novel/hard-to-predict; low = well-modeled.

occlusion_events.description: Times and regions where the codec's inter-frame prediction failed hard, or where the retinal transform's motion correlation broke — evidence of occlusion, disocclusion, or novel content.

texture_vocabulary.description: Small learned/derived vocabulary of texture primitives used by entity texture_codes. Each entry describes ONE texture identity structurally (DCT coefficient signature, edge histogram signature, or radiance-field gradient signature) — not a pixel patch. Deterministic per (path, source_kind, translator_version).

signature.description: Compact signature (e.g. base64-encoded low-dim descriptor). Structural, not raw pixels.

frequency.description: How many times this code was assigned in this record.

temporal_markers.description: Scene-level events: cuts (I-frame insertions in codec path; discontinuities in temporal derivative in retinal path), global camera motion, lighting shifts.

detail.description: Kind-specific fields. camera_motion may carry {global_vx, global_vy, zoom}. lighting_change may carry {delta_luminance}. Non-normative.

retinal_fields.description: Present when path='retinal'. Compact summaries of the four differential fields at record-level granularity. Not full tensors — those live in the on-disk artifact the record references.

gradient_energy_mean.description: Mean magnitude of spatial gradient |∇L| over the stream.

temporal_derivative_mean.description: Mean magnitude of ∂L/∂t over the stream.

motion_correlation_coherence.description: 0 = random flow; 1 = perfectly coherent global motion.

tensor_ref.description: Optional: path to the on-disk four-field tensor, if persisted. Backend-only; never a public URL.

notes.description: Honest disclosures from the extractor: codec blind spots hit (fast motion at cuts, texture under masking), sensor/transform limits (frame rate insufficient for full temporal derivative, spectral response unknown, etc.). Mom's Law: what this record could NOT see.
